description: Na₃Pb₂(SO₄)₃Cl crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five O and two equivalent Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.73 Å. Both Na-Cl bond lengths are 3.17 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.57-2.99 Å. There are two inequivalent Pb sites. In the first Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five O and two equivalent Cl atoms. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.62 Å. Both Pb-Cl bond lengths are 3.05 Å. In the second Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five O and two equivalent Cl atoms. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.71 Å. Both Pb-Cl bond lengths are 3.13 Å. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.51 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.51 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.51 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Pb, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one Pb, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two Pb, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one Pb, and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, one Pb, and one S atom. Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Pb atoms to form face-sharing ClNa₂Pb₄ octahedra.
